pages.text: Transform the velocity vector using spatial modifiers to control movement on each update.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 1 per projectile per tick; motion of decorative particles is free.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.05; controlled motion also includes its modifiers, counted once.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
